name: A2O LITE NEON Dance: Do the Duo Intro From Your Photos
blurb: The A2O LITE NEON dance is the TikTok trend built on the duo intro of "NEON", A2O LITE's debut song (13 October 2026): two dancers sway, spin, kick and hit a high-and-low pose.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same glass-roofed atrium between tall grey concrete buildings, the wooden wall panels, the dark polished floor, the same fixed low camera, framing, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the woman with long light-brown hair in the cropped white jacket and grey camouflage cargo pants, who dances on the left, is now the person in [Image 1], and the woman in the grey beanie and dark striped top, who dances on the right, is now the person in [Image 2].

Use [Image 1] and [Image 2] as the appearance references for the two performers in the K-pop intro dance. Keep each person's face, hairstyle, outfit, body proportions, and screen position consistent; do not swap roles or merge identities. Use [Video 1] to guide the visible two-person intro choreography, movement order, rhythm, timing, and interaction. Recreate only the actions shown in the reference; do not invent additional steps. Keep both performers fully visible in a steady, front-facing full-body shot with the same background and lighting throughout. SAME IDENTITY. FIXED POSITIONS. NO ROLE SWAP. NO DUPLICATE. NO NEW SCENES. Avoid extra dancers, fused or duplicated limbs, distorted hands, foot sliding, outfit flicker, background drift, and camera cuts.

Dancer 1 (left) = the person in [Image 1], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 1] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). They wear the clothes and shoes from [Image 1]. NO cropped white jacket and no camouflage cargo pants unless [Image 1] shows them.

Dancer 2 (right) = the person in [Image 2], in EVERY frame: copy the exact face from [Image 2] (the face shape, eye color and eye shape, eyebrows, nose, mouth, skin tone, age, hair color, hair length and hairstyle, and any beard, moustache, glasses or freckles). They wear the clothes and shoes from [Image 2]. NO grey beanie and no striped top unless [Image 2] shows them.

The same real people from the first second to the last, so their friends recognize them at once. Never morph, never drift back to the original dancers' faces. Both change: no one from the video stays, also when only the back of a head shows.

The dance, matching the reference second by second:
0-2 s: side by side, dancer 1 a step in front, both sway and open their arms.
2-4.5 s: arms up on a diagonal, then a sway and a side step.
4.5-7.5 s: a low lean, then dancer 1 spins with a high kick while dancer 2 dances behind.
7.5-11.5 s: they split apart with wide lunges and arm swings.
11.5-13 s: dancer 1 drops low to the floor while dancer 2 stands on one leg, knee up, one hand raised.
13-15 s: both come up, throw their arms out wide and end in a wide squat, hands on the knees.

One head per person, on that person's own shoulders. A face never appears on knees, legs, hands or clothes. Exactly two people. No text, no logos, no watermark.

prompts.text:
Use the uploaded image as the identity and wardrobe reference for one dancer inspired by a K-pop intro performance. Preserve the same face, hairstyle, outfit, and body proportions throughout. Use the reference video to guide a simplified solo recreation of the visible movement, matching its rhythm and timing without adding choreography that is not shown. Keep the dancer centered and fully visible in a steady, front-facing full-body shot. Preserve the scene and lighting of the uploaded image; do not add other performers or switch locations. SAME IDENTITY. NO DUPLICATE. NO NEW SCENES. Avoid role changes, extra limbs, distorted hands, foot sliding, clothing flicker, background drift, and sudden camera cuts.
Replace the character in the video with the person from the uploaded image. Keep actions, poses, facial expressions and rhythm. Preserve the person's original facial features, maintain character consistency, no distortion, no glitches, no artifacts. The person dances in the clothes and shoes from the uploaded image, not the light-blue fitted top or the white wide cargo pants of the dancer in the video, and keeps their own hair from the uploaded image, not long straight black hair. Follow the dancer's moves and timing exactly: the hair flick with one hand at the chest, the lean back with one arm raised high on a diagonal, the hand on the hip and the hand by the face, the jump into a wide stance, the side walk with a hair whip, the high kick to the side, the arms thrown out wide, the arms up with quick side steps and the knee lift at the end. Keep the whole body in view from head to feet, with natural balance and stable ground contact. Exactly one person, no other people. One continuous shot, no text, no captions, no logos.

prompts.label: 1. The video prompt is filled in. Settings: Seedance 2.5, 15 s, 720p, 9:16, sound off. The video prompt
prompts.text:
Recreate the reference video [Video 1] shot for shot: the same plain lavender studio and floor, the same soft light, the same single camera with its push-ins and pull-backs, the same framing, timing and dance moves. The ONLY change: the cat who dances upright on the left is now the pet in [Image 1], and the cat who dances upright on the right is now the pet in [Image 2]. Both change: no cat from the video stays, not its head, ears, body or coat.

The pet on the left = the pet in [Image 1], whole body, in EVERY frame: the same species and breed, head shape, face shape, muzzle, eyes, eye color, ear size and shape, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 1], with the natural body volume, size and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything.

The pet on the right = the pet in [Image 2], whole body, in EVERY frame, also when it spins, jumps close to the camera and drops to the floor: the same species and breed, head shape, face shape, muzzle, eyes, eye color, ear size and shape, fur colors, fur length and markings as in [Image 2], with the natural body volume, size and proportions of that animal: never flattened, squashed, stretched or merged with anything.

Each pet keeps its own face shape: a flat round face stays flat and round with small round ears, a long face stays long. NO tall pointed ears with tufted tips and no long narrow face unless the photo shows them. A long-haired pet stays long-haired and fluffy, a short-haired pet stays short-haired: fur length, fluff and body size never come from the cats in the video. Each coat is not the coat of the cat in the video: the colors and pattern come only from the pet's own photo, the same on the head, chest, belly, legs and tail. The same two pets from the first second to the last, so their owners instantly recognize them. Never morph, never drift back to the cats of the video. Do not mix the two pets: [Image 1] is only the pet on the left, [Image 2] is only the pet on the right. If a photo shows a dog or another animal, that animal takes the same place, upright on its hind legs, with the same moves.

The dance, one continuous take, matching the reference second by second:
[0-2 s]: wide, side by side, upright, they sway with the front paws at the chest.
[2-5 s]: the camera moves in; both point their front paws to the side, then turn sideways and step, tails swinging.
[5-8 s]: the pet on the right spins with its back to the camera, then leaps toward the camera and fills the right half of the frame.
[8-12 s]: they split apart, front legs out wide; the pet on the left raises one front paw high.
[12-13 s]: the pet on the right drops low to the floor on all four legs, the pet on the left stands tall, one paw up.
[13-15 s]: both stand upright again and spread their front legs wide, facing the camera.

Anatomy rules: one head per pet, on its own body, one tail each. Real round furry paws, no fingers, no thumbs, no human hands. Exactly two animals. No people, no extra animals, no text, no logos, no watermark. No dialogue throughout the entire video. No background music.
